title: Claude Code Skill Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter for SKILL.md files. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills#frontmatter-reference

name.description: Display name for the skill. If omitted, uses the directory name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (max 64 characters).

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Claude uses this to decide when to apply the skill. Combined with when_to_use, truncated at 1,536 characters in the skill listing.

when_to_use.description: Additional context for when Claude should invoke the skill, such as trigger phrases or example requests. Appended to description in the skill listing.

argument-hint.description: Hint shown during autocomplete to indicate expected arguments. Example: '[issue-number]' or '[filename] [format]'.

arguments.description: Named positional arguments for $name substitution in the skill content.

disable-model-invocation.description: Set to true to prevent Claude from automatically loading this skill. Use for workflows you want to trigger manually with /name.

user-invocable.description: Set to false to hide from the / menu. Use for background knowledge users shouldn't invoke directly.

allowed-tools.description: Tools Claude can use without asking permission when this skill is active.

model.description: Model to use when this skill is active. Accepts the same values as /model, or 'inherit' to keep the active model.

effort.description: Effort level when this skill is active. Overrides the session effort level.

context.description: Set to 'fork' to run in a forked subagent context.

agent.description: Which subagent type to use when context: fork is set. Options include built-in agents (Explore, Plan, general-purpose) or any custom subagent.

hooks.description: Hooks scoped to this skill's lifecycle. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#hooks-in-skills-and-agents

paths.description: Glob patterns that limit when this skill is activated. When set, Claude loads the skill automatically only when working with files matching the patterns.

shell.description: Shell to use for !`command` and ```! blocks in this skill.
